LIBTPU_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install libtpu. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, and 'from-source' compiles from source.

LIBTPU_VERSION.description: Specific version of libtpu to install.

LIBTPU_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading libtpu binary or archive artifacts.

LIBTPU_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying libtpu available remote releases.

LIBTPU_WHEEL_ARCH.description: Wheel architecture(s) to fetch and extract ('x86_64', 'aarch64', or 'both').

LIBTPU_SO_PATH.description: Explicit override path to an extracted upstream libtpu.so shared object.

LIBTPU_SDK_SO_PATH.description: Explicit override path to an extracted upstream sdk.so / sdk.abi3.so shared object.

LIBTPU_REFERENCE_DIR.description: Resolved directory containing extracted upstream libtpu reference wheels and shared objects.

LIBTPU_REFERENCE_SO.description: Resolved path to the active host-matching upstream libtpu.so artifact.

LIBTPU_REFERENCE_SDK_SO.description: Resolved path to the active host-matching upstream sdk.so artifact.

LIBTPU_ACTIVATE_TPU_LIBRARY_PATH.description: Flag (0 or 1) controlling whether env.sh/env.cmd exports TPU_LIBRARY_PATH pointing at upstream libtpu.so.
